originalTitle: Dow Jones Futures Rise After AI Stocks Tumble On OpenAI News; SpaceX Move Slams Verizon, AT&T Late
summary: AI stocks sold off on OpenAI but much of the market was fine. Apple flashed a buy signal. A SpaceX spectrum buy hit Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile late.
